stories.summary: The Guardian's review calls Apple's AirPods 5 the best open-fit earbuds yet, citing upgraded noise cancellation, sound and controls that compete with many similarly priced in-ear models. The cheaper new earbuds retain an open design for people who dislike silicone tips and are offered in versions with or without wireless charging.

links.headline: Apple AirPods 5 review: the best open-fit earbuds yet
links.excerpt: Upgraded, cheaper AirPods have noise cancelling, sound and controls to rival many plugged-in buds but without tips Apple’s latest AirPods set a new standard for open-fit buds with upgraded noise cancelling that now rivals many plugged-in designs of the same price. The AirPods 5 have the same design the popular AirPods 4 offering an option for those that do not like silicone ear tips used by most noise cancelling earbuds. stories.title: Leading China Property Developer Reports Huge loss, in Sign of Widening Real-Estate Woes
stories.summary: Chinese property developer Vanke has reported a huge loss, adding to signs that the country's real-estate crisis is widening. The Wall Street Journal says Vanke's difficulties raise questions about how far the crisis will spread and whether the Chinese state will intervene.

stories.title: Freed Israeli Hostages Still Had Shrapnel in Their Bodies From Oct. 7 Attack
stories.summary: Some freed Israeli hostages still had shrapnel in their bodies from the October 7 attack, according to an Israeli medical official cited by the Wall Street Journal. The official said some of the women were held alone for extended periods and spent eight months in tunnels.
